summary: Working to bring in such a strong team of mentors. All #femhack funds go to efforts to support teams. But we will not ask people, especially underrepresented folks with mad skills, to do this important work for free. It is a #socialjustice award.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Working to bring in such a strong team of mentors. All #femhack funds go to efforts to support teams. But we will not ask people, especially underrepresented folks with mad skills, to do this important work for free. It is a #socialjustice award.
